title: The 10 Best Places to Buy Aluminum Online in 2026: 6061, 7075, and 7050 Plate Ranked
summary: Ten places to buy aluminum plate online for 6061, 7075 and 7050, listed alphabetically with the job each one fits best. Published by NOX METALS.
body_markdown:
### Where can I buy aluminum online?


It depends on order size and certification requirements. For custom-cut certified 6061, 7075 or 7050 plate with a delivered price and ship date before you order, NOX METALS. For a single small piece with no minimum order, Online Metals. For metal you can pick up within the hour, Metal Supermarkets. For a mixed bill of materials across several metals, Ryerson. For metals and engineering plastics on one order, Alro Steel. For mid-size cut-to-size aluminum orders, Midwest Steel & Aluminum. For precision-sawn blanks, TW Metals or Howard Precision Metals.


### Where can I buy 6061 aluminum plate online?


Most suppliers on this list carry 6061. NOX METALS cuts 6061-T651 plate to size up to 60.5 x 144.5 inches, with mill certs included and the thicknesses in stock shown in the instant quote. For one small piece, Online Metals has no minimum order, and Metal Supermarkets will cut it while you wait if there is a store near you.


### Where can I buy 7075 and 7050 aluminum plate online?


7075 and 7050 are aerospace alloys, so fewer suppliers carry them in depth. NOX METALS stocks 7075-T651 and T7351 and 7050-T7451, cut to size up to 60.5 x 144.5 inches with instant quoting and DFARS-compliant material available for plate. TW Metals lists 7075 plate in T651 and T7351, and Speedy Metals and Metal Supermarkets list 7075 plate.


### Is it cheaper to buy aluminum online or from a local supplier?


Online suppliers publish prices, which makes them easy to compare. The exception is urgency: if you need material today, a local pickup can be worth paying more for. The bigger lever is buying close to your finished size, because you pay for less metal you machine away.


### Do online aluminum suppliers provide mill certifications?


Some include them, some charge extra, and some cannot provide them at all, so ask. Certifications with heat number and lot traceability are mandatory for aerospace, defense and most structural work. NOX METALS includes full mill certs with heat/lot traceability on every order and is ISO 9001:2015 certified.


### What is the cheapest way to buy aluminum plate?


Buy the right shape rather than negotiating the rate. Plate cut close to your part, or a certified remnant that already fits it, means you pay for less metal. NoxDrops lists production offcuts priced by alloy and weight. Beyond that, check order minimums before comparing per-pound rates, and do not specify a more expensive alloy than your part needs.


### How long does it take to get aluminum plate delivered?


It depends on whether your order is a stock pull or a mill order. McMaster-Carr says most of its orders arrive same or next day, and walk-in stores like Metal Supermarkets cut while you wait. At NOX METALS, your ship date is calculated in under 60 seconds with your instant quote, before you order. A mill order for an unusual size or thick 7xxx section takes far longer, so confirm which one you are buying before you schedule around it.


### What should I look for when choosing an aluminum supplier?


Six things: whether mill certifications with heat numbers are included or extra, the order minimum, whether the temper is correct for the thickness (T651 rather than T6 at 0.250 inch and above), the melt origin (DFARS, domestic or any origin), whether cutting and processing charges are included in the quote, and the ship date. Those six questions surface almost every hidden cost and schedule risk in a plate order.
